how_to_use: Add an entry to the 'confirmed' list when the kitchen staff confirms something about a dish.
match: a word from the dish name (German or English), for example "Paprikahendl" or "Zwiebelsuppe".
note: what the kitchen said (optional). Use note_de and note_en to write it in both languages.
date: only for this one day, YYYY-MM-DD (optional). until: valid until this day, YYYY-MM-DD (optional).
A halal confirmation clears the doubtful points of a dish, but never overrides a pork label.
Copy the example below into the list, change it, and click 'Commit changes'. The website updates within a minute.

example.note_en: Chicken from a halal-certified supplier (asked on 08.10.2026)
example.note_de: Huhn von einem halal-zertifizierten Lieferanten (gefragt am 08.10.2026)
